feature.name: Shape styles
feature.what_it_does: Style the fill, outline and effects of a selected shape/chart/SmartArt shape from a gallery or individually.
feature.affects: the fill/outline/effect styling of the selected drawing object
feature.behavior: Style the fill, outline and effects of a selected shape/chart/SmartArt shape from a gallery or individually. Group controls: subfeature:shape-effects, subfeature:shape-fill, subfeature:shape-format-pane, subfeature:shape-outline, subfeature:shape-style-gallery

connections.why: measured: the hosting contextual tab appears only in this object's context

subfeatures.name: Shape Effects
subfeatures.what_it_does: Applies shadow/reflection/glow/bevel/3D effects to the shape (menu of families).
subfeatures.behavior: Opens the Shape Effects dropdown — the surface that presents this capability's options (8 controls enumerated in the structural pass). Applying a choice there changes: the shape's visual effects.
